Propose: Do not propose repair_level_shift when level_excursion_score is zero or estimated_level_offset is zero. Do not stack clipping, smoothing, or decompose steps to stand in for an absent level mechanism. Bind only operators whose mechanism matches an emitted hypothesis; if no legal binding exists, return an empty candidate set.
Select: Prefer identity when the only verified non-identity program is an intrinsic level rewrite without public level scores, or when evidence is only a non-localized robust-z peak. Choose a non-identity program only when its mechanism is supported by the current public features. Record the chosen id explicitly.

Inspect: emit a missingness hypothesis only from gap features (missing_fraction, longest_missing_run_fraction); if local_robust_z_peak is high, keep a disjoint extreme_deviation hypothesis rather than merging the whole span. Propose: do not use a missingness-filling operator as the exploration candidate from gaps alone; skip it when it would be inert. If extreme_deviation is hypothesized, address it with one intrinsic robust-deviation or clipping operator (hampel_filter, outlier_iqr, outlier_mad, or winsorize) that needs no external region. A second candidate is allowed only when it is effect-distinct (different mechanism family or step order), not a parameter-only variant. Select: choose identity when every verified non-identity candidate is missingness-filling; a verified intrinsic robust-deviation candidate may be chosen when it addresses the extreme_deviation hypothesis. Do not pursue a non-identity rate, operator quota, or named workflow. Soft guidance; later job feedback may override.
predicted_data_effect: Sequences with positive missing_fraction and unknown imputation_probe_direction are more often left unmodified when the only verified non-identity programs are missingness-filling.
When a disjoint high local_robust_z_peak is also present, prepared values may change only at intrinsically located robust-deviation or clipping hit points rather than by gap-filling.
falsification_condition: A verified missingness-filling program improves the job metric versus identity on sequences with missing_fraction > 0, imputation_probe_direction unknown, and no high local_robust_z_peak or nonzero level_excursion_score.
This skill is retrieved on a sequence with missing_fraction == 0 or imputation_probe_direction other than unknown.
